basic_info.name: United Heavy Lift GmbH & Co. KG
basic_info.description: DRIVEN BY PASSION – Our mission is to ensure long-term business relationships through customer satisfaction.UNITED HEAVY LIFT is a dynamic, growing, and internationally operating shipping company in the Heavy Lift segment. Our fleet of diversified vessels consists of modern Heavy Lift Vessels (up to 900 ton lifting capacity), Deck Carriers and Semi-Subs (modular carriers). UNITED HEAVY LIFT's highly experienced team of operators and chartering specialists offers our clients and principals a wide range of services, providing effective, innovative and tailor-made Heavy Lift transport solutions. We find innovative answers for challenging projects. UNITED HEAVY LIFT closely cooperates with our partner companies UNITED WIND LOGISTICS and UNITED ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS. Get to know us at www.unitedheavylift.deUnsolicited job applications are always welcome. Contact us at career(at)unitedheavylift.de. Check out our current job offers at ww.unitedheavylift.de/career

basic_info.name: Soloplan GmbH
basic_info.description: Soloplan GmbH is THE software company for the logistics industry. As one of the leading German logistics software companies, we develop and distribute our innovative and flexible logistics software suite CarLo worldwide. Over the course of 30 years, Soloplan has developed into a medium-sized company that operates successfully with around 260 employees at its headquarters in Kempten/Allgäu and in other branches in Germany, Poland, France, South Africa and Spain. Our employees appreciate our fair, sustainable and future-orientated business practices as well as the pleasant working environment.CarLo is THE logistics software for the perfect handling of all transport processes: from order entry and planning - including automatic route planning - to freight calculation and fleet management through to BI systems for data analysis.More than 1,800 customers in over 50 countries worldwide benefit from direct sales of the CarLo product family, seminars at the in-house Soloplan Academy and the competent, efficient service team on site and on the internal hotline.Thanks to our success, our company is growing and we are looking to maintain our level of quality and performance in the future: Open-minded, team-orientated specialists in the areas of - software development- quality assurance- IT services- project management- product management- sales and marketing- administration

basic_info.name: Metroplan®
basic_info.description: Metroplan is a leading technical consultancy and planning company. From our sites in Hamburg and Wrocław, we design comprehensive solutions for production and logistics locations. Our high implementation expertise, interdisciplinary approach and efficient project management set us apart from the competition. Our experience is based on sound analysis and hard facts. So we provide security for investment decisions and create the conditions needed for the success of our customers. Sustainable and with passion.

basic_info.name: Elflein Spedition & Transport GmbH
basic_info.description: ELFLEIN connects the business segments transport, JIT/JIS, storage and logistics. We focus on supplying the automobile segment as well as on paper industry and food.Further information you can find on our website: https://www.elflein.de/en/

basic_info.name: V-LINE EUROPE GmbH
basic_info.description: The V-LINE GROUP is a global group of companies specializing in supply chain solutions for MRO spare parts always focusing on the customer’s success, based upon more than 45 years of business experience. With a wide range of innovative service solutions, V-LINE covers the entire Maintenance, Repair and Operations supply chain and is constantly adapting to new market requirements and setting new standards as part of the digital transformation.The V-LINE GROUP is headquartered in Sehnde near Hanover, Germany, and has worldwide locations in Saudi Arabia, Mexico, USA, Korea, China, Japan and Brazil. Our data protection declaration: https://www.v-line.com/data-protection/

basic_info.name: LOGSOL GmbH
basic_info.description: Innovative Logistiksoftware in Verbindung mit strategischer Logistik- und Fabrikplanung: LOGSOL berät weltweit Unternehmen entlang der gesamten Supply Chain. Unser 360-Grad-Blick und über 25-jährige Logistik-Expertise ermöglichen die optimale Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei Themen wie z. B. innovativen Behälterkonzepten, Prozessoptimierungen oder Materialfluss- und Layoutplanungen. Dabei bauen wir auf gemeinschaftliche Erfolge: Klare Vorteile für unsere Kunden ermöglichen einzigartige Perspektiven für unsere Mitarbeitenden und schaffen dadurch ein starkes, kontinuierliches Wachstum. Wir nutzen das Potenzial unseres Teams und fördern kreatives Denken.Logisch. Logistisch. LOGSOL.

basic_info.name: PTV Logistics
basic_info.description: PTV Logistics stands today as a dedicated brand focused entirely on solving modern logistics challenges — with full global autonomy and a clear mission.Built on more than 40 years of logistics expertise within the PTV ecosystem, PTV Logistics enables smarter, more efficient, and more transparent logistics operations worldwide.The company combines advanced routing, optimization, transport visibility, and AI‐driven intelligence on a unified technology foundation. Powerful algorithms and scalable APIs form the backbone of all PTV Logistics SaaS solutions, ensuring reliable performance and consistent capabilities across planning and execution.Together, these strengths position PTV Logistics as an end‐to‐end logistics technology provider, helping organizations plan, execute, and optimize transport operations with confidence.Across its solution portfolio, PTV Logistics supports organizations throughout the entire logistics lifecycle - enabling them to plan, optimize, execute, and continuously develop their transport operations. From strategic decision‐making to daily execution and ongoing improvement, PTV Logistics helps turn complexity into operational excellence.

basic_info.name: Captrain Deutschland-Group
basic_info.description: Whether it's international traction, industrial railway operations or transport concepts tailored to your individual processes, we are your partner for innovative, customised and efficient logistics solutions. Our operational offices in Germany, the Netherlands and Poland, licences in Austria and the Czech Republic, as well as affiliates in Belgium, France, Italy, Spain and Switzerland, ensure that we have both an international and local presence.

basic_info.name: Fleet Logistics Group
basic_info.description: Fleet Logistics is a leading Fleet Management service provider in Europe, part of TraXall International, with 30 years of experience and 180,000 vehicles serviced across 29 countries. We provide fleet and mobility management services to large corporations, offering a fully outsourced solution that covers a wide range of processes for eligible employees and company needs.

basic_info.name: ELSEN Unternehmensgruppe
basic_info.description: Die ELSEN Unternehmensgruppe ist ein inhabergeführtes, international auf-gestelltes Unternehmen, das seine Kunden als Full-Service-Logistikdienstleister entlang der gesamten Supply Chain bedient: Das Produktportfolio bietet neben der ganzheitlichen Supply Chain Beratung auch operative Tätigkeiten wie Transport und Übernahme von einfachen bis hin zu sehr komplexen produktionslogistischen Tätigkeiten, ergänzt durch weitere Produktbereiche wie Qualitätsmanagement, Personaldienstleistungen und Value Added Services. ELSEN betreut sowohl internationale Top Player der Automobilzulieferer-, der Elektro- und der Luftfahrtindustrie sowie des Handels als auch viele mittelständische Unternehmen aus den verschiedensten Bereichen. An rund 30 Standorten in Europa arbeiten über 1.600 Mitarbeiter. Das operative Geschäft wird von dem Standort Koblenz geleitet, während die Verwaltung ihren Sitz in Wittlich hat. Weitere größere Niederlassungen befinden sich in Edenkoben, Schwäbisch Hall, Zwickau, Saarlouis und Nürnberg. Mehrheitsgesellschafter sind die Familien Groß-Elsen sowie Groß.
